comment: The shaper is a windowed sine fold that crosses over to the clip level as the driven signal passes about 0.93 of the window, and the crossover is smoothed with a cubic blend (Clpy.cpp:69). Supersampling runs the shaper at eight sub-steps, interpolating the clip CV as well as the signal, and follows it with a post-filter (Clpy.cpp:48).
